//: WHY THIS EXISTS. The root tsconfig includes only **/*.ts and **/*.tsx and
leaves checkJs off, so `pnpm typecheck` never type-checked a single line of
this detector — its .mjs modules were pulled in as imports and given syntax
checking only. Every JSDoc type in them was decorative. That was proven by
injecting a JSDoc violation and getting zero diagnostics, and it is not a
cosmetic gap: the defect that ended the flat model was a semantic dimension
added to one consumer of a shared record and not the other, which a checked
type would have refused to compile.
